notes.title: New teaser trailer, half release date, SFXs including moans, demo and more!
notes.notes: [p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]I'm eager to share some amazing progress what I have made on Sex Hill. Let's jump right into the juicy details![/p][p][/p][p]Firstly, the release date. I can confidently confirm that the game will be released in 2026! I know that it's just a half release date, but I still hope this is something what you can be excited for.[/p][p][/p][p]Secondly, a demo will be released before the launch. Yes you heard it right. You will have the chance to try the first part of the game completely free before the full release. More information about the demo will be shared prior its launch![/p][p][/p][p]Thirdly, hundreds of SFX are added to the game including moans and sex sounds. This feature was highly requested in my first game and I hear you all! Thanks to the SFX, the sex scenes are going to be even more steamier than before.[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, here are some some previews and an amazing teaser trailer. Don't forget to watch the teaser trailer too after looking at these new preview images. Until the next news update, Bye~bye.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602808/4f3a3572873ad71196b85e5ebb57e4617e0bf832.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602808/e280963e3f169f9ee9c589cddd09cb6cd79dfed7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602808/3b01c6ef451e5661172a06963daaf33fc3679782.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602808/01e06a5760602fa7196a803a1de8c3ecc1b2d1b9.png"][/img][/p]
